correctness.rationale: Blowing up the degree-4 Frobenius orbit B in P2(F16) gives K^2=5 and anticanonical cubics through B; one F16 evaluation is four independent F2 linear conditions, leaving 63 nonzero binary cubics. For a cubic through B, geometric singularity occurs over extensions of F2 of degree at most 3 (a reduced plane cubic has at most three geometric singularities, while a nonreduced repeated F2 line cannot contain B). A separate exact F2/F4/F8 finite-field singular-point enumerator recovered 63 sections, 18 smooth sections and exactly four all-smooth 2D subspaces with member F2-point distribution (1,1,5); 18 smooth points split by F2 rational point counts 1:5,2:4,4:4,5:5. For the sample pencil (0x189,0x2e4,0x36d) the affine Groebner basis is Z+Y^8+Y^7+Y^6+Y^5 and Y^9+Y^5+Y^4+Y^3+Y^2+Y+1=(Y^4+Y+1)(Y^5+Y^2+1), irreducible squarefree factors, and no common points on X=0; subtracting blown-up degree-4 B leaves a reduced degree-5 geometric orbit. The proof uses Boitrel to exclude non-linear automorphisms and verifies a four-element transitive C4 action, hence all four base loci have the same type. Scope is this one F2 surface, not an arbitrary field classification.
